title: : SHAPED FOR SUCCESS
verse: them: "Prosper! Reproduce! Fill Earth! Take
body: : SHAPED FOR SUCCESS “God created human beings; he created them godlike, Reflecting God's nature. God blessed them: "Prosper! Reproduce! Fill Earth! Take charge! Be responsible." (TBCL) Gen 1:27-28 You're – created and fashioned – to be master over everything on earth. You are no ordinary being – you're designed for dominion, configured to be in charge and formed for fruitfulness and allround fulfillment. It's mind-blowing the way TLB presents Gen 1:27-28, “So God made man like his Maker. Like God did God make man; Man and maid did he make them. And God blessed them and told them, "Multiply and fill the earth and subdue it; you are masters of the fish and birds and all the animals.” James 3:9 says, “.[you're] made after the similitude of God” (KJV). We’re uniquely endowed to perform different divine obligations. God shaped you for success. This was the reason He said, “Be fruitful, multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it [using all its vast resources in the service of God and man].” He's fulfilled in your fulfilment.
prayer: Father, thank You for my shape. I step into my place in destiny [into the realms of success and dominion]. No failure of any kind for me and my household in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : IT ALL BEGINS WITH GOD
verse: in him and finds its purpose in him” (TBCL) Col 1:16
body: : IT ALL BEGINS WITH GOD “. absolutely everything. everything got started in him and finds its purpose in him” (TBCL) Col 1:16 Expression of your divine purpose on earth begins with, continues in and culminates in God. You exist by Him and for Him. Col 2:10 says “And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power” (KJV). Your completeness is in God. Without Him, you can do nothing. NIV of our text reads, “For by him all things were created. all things were created by him and for him.” The simplest way to discover the purpose of a design is to ask the master designer. The same is true of discovering life purpose. You're a creature. He's the Creator. If you can ask Him, He won't leave you in the dark. “And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son” (KJV) John 14:13. Besides, as owner's manual is of help to every design, so is the Word of God. It's our owner's manual to guide us through, Ps 119:105 says, That's it – you can see through the Word!
prayer: Dear Father, I commit myself to Your Hand. I'm aware, without You there is nothing I can do. Guide me through so as to fulfill Your purpose in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : CHARACTER MA TTERS IN THE SCHOOL OF SUCCESS
verse: grasp that which is life indeed (AMP) 1Tim 6:18-19
body: : CHARACTER MA TTERS IN THE SCHOOL OF SUCCESS “[Charge them] to do good, to be rich in good works, to be liberal and generous of heart, ready to share [with others], In this way laying up for themselves [the riches that endure forever as] a good foundation for the future, so that they may grasp that which is life indeed (AMP) 1Tim 6:18-19 The Bible declares, “. that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men” (WEB) Titus 3:8. This is what it takes to succeed – good works – either as a CEO, apprentice, business man, wife, husband or servant. It pays – for it's pleasant and profitable. The world needs men who keep to their words, men who will make no compromise with wrong, men whose conscience cannot be bought, men who put character first above every other thing, men who are not ashamed to stand for the truth even when it is unpopular, men who will not lose their integrity in the midst of corruption, men who will be as honest in all things. “Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men” (KJV) 2 Cor 8:21.
confession: Having a firm hold of the Word, I’ll be more careful to maintain good works in all I do.

title: : MAKING STEPPING ST ONES OUT OF STUMBLING BLOCKS
verse: well able to do it” (DB) Num 13:30
body: : MAKING STEPPING ST ONES OUT OF STUMBLING BLOCKS “And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up boldly and possess it, for we are well able to do it” (DB) Num 13:30 And they returned from searching out the land “ after forty days. And they came, and went to Moses. And they told him, and said, We came to the land to which thou didst send us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey.” (DB) Num 13:25-29. The remaining ten people came up with this report, “. We are not able to go up against the people. saying, The land. is a land that eateth up its inhabitants; and all the people that we have seen in it are men of great stature; and there have we seen giants. and we were in our sight as grasshoppers, and so we were also in their sight” (DB) Num 13:31-33. Never be like the spies who were so vile in their imaginations. Stumbling blocks are those blocks that are divinely orchestrated to serve as stepping stones on your way to success. In your life pursuit, three things are to be done. One, maintain a right thinking pattern. Two, speak faith even when all you can see is failure. Three, align your imagination with the Word of God, Ps 1:1-3.
prayer: Father, I’ll live to making every stumbling block a stepping stone in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : THE PLACE OF LOGOS IN SUCCESS
verse: successful in everything you do” (ERV) Jos 1:8
body: : THE PLACE OF LOGOS IN SUCCESS “Always remember what is written in that book of law. Speak about that book and study it day and night. Then you can be sure to obey what is written there. If you do this, you will be wise and successful in everything you do” (ERV) Jos 1:8 TBCL puts Jos 1:8 thus, “And don't for a minute let this Book of The Revelation be out of mind. Ponder and meditate on it day and night, making sure you practice everything written in it. Then you'll get where you're going; then you'll succeed” The Word gets you going and ultimately guarantees your success. So, study the Word [Take in the Word via in-depth study]. Speak the Word [Talk the Word to your spirit]. And above all, submit to the Word. Go through the Amplified Version of Jos 1:8, “This Book of the Law shall not depart out of your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe and do according to all that is written in it. For then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall deal wisely and have good success.” Deut 29:9
confession: I believe in the power of the Word. I’ll daily study, speak and submit to the Word. I am a wonder to the world by His Word. I am going places. I am achieving His dreams for my life.

title: : THE PLACE OF PRA YER IN SUCCESS
verse: “. by strength shall no man prevail” (KJV) 1 Sam
body: : THE PLACE OF PRA YER IN SUCCESS “. by strength shall no man prevail” (KJV) 1 Sam 2:9 It is said of Alexander the Great that a courtier asked him for some financial aid. The great leader told him to go to his treasurer and ask for whatever he wanted. A little later, the treasurer came to Alexander: the man had asked for a large sum and that he hesitated to pay out so much. “Give him what he asks for,” replied the great conqueror. “He has treated me like a king in his asking, and I shall be like a king in my giving.” Always ask it big and you'll always get it big. Prayer is that weapon with which you get what you want and turn things around in the realm of the spirit. Don't just be a prayer warrior; be a prayer winner. Be an energetic agonizer! A vibrant petitioner! A dynamic pray-er! 1Thes 5:17 KJV says, “Pray without ceasing.” Nonstop prayer guarantees nonstop success.“Be unceasing in prayer [praying perseveringly]” (Amp). That's the key - persistence, doggedness and tenacity. Keep praying and trusting, Heb 10:37-39.
prayer: Dear Father, I ask for divine enablement and supernatural assistance to be an earnest agonizer and petitioner in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : TODAY MATTERS IN THE SCHOOL OF SUCCESS
verse: turn out in the end” (TBCL) Ecc 11:6
body: : TODAY MATTERS IN THE SCHOOL OF SUCCESS “Go to work in the morning and stick to it until evening without watching the clock. You never know from moment to moment how your work will turn out in the end” (TBCL) Ecc 11:6 Every day counts and so, is every hour and every single minute. You’re the only one who can make your day purposeful. “This is the day which LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it” (KJV) Ps 118:24. He made today for your making. Take responsibility! Be a working worker. No gain in idleness. Don't be in the class of those who watch the work. Just work the work. “Oh. don't take a single day for granted. Take delight in each lightfilled hour. You who are young, make the most of your youth. Relish your youthful vigor. Follow the impulses of your heart. If something looks good to you, pursue it. But know also that not just anything goes; You have to answer to God for every last bit of it. Live footloose and fancy free - You won't be young forever.” Eccl 11:7-10. Every day matters in the school of success!
prayer: Sweet Jesus, so grateful for the illumination from Your Word. My heart is full of joy. Behold, I go right ahead to make each day count in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : YOU’RE NOT AN ACCIDENT
verse: servant, my very favorite” (CEV) Isa 44:2
body: : YOU’RE NOT AN ACCIDENT “I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. You are my chosen servant, my very favorite” (CEV) Isa 44:2 ‘He is my Creator. I was in His care even before I was born. I am His chosen servant, God's very favorite.’ Say the above to yourself over and over again until your spirit begins to respond to the Word. Your parents might not have planned you, but He planned and planted you in your mother's womb. They might have called you a mistake but He called you a miracle. You are never a miscalculation. No, not a misprint! By God's design, you're a marvel! You are a wonder of creation! No one on earth [past or present] is exactly like you. And no one in the future would be like you. He’ll help you. He said it and He will do it. Brood over Isa 43:1, “But now, says the Lord your Maker, O Jacob, and your life-giver, O Israel: have no fear.” (KJV). He is your Maker - you’re His! You're groomed to glow! You're formed to flourish! You're made to matter! Hallelujah!
confession: I am not a coincidence – I didn't come by trial and error – no, never a misfortune. I am not a disappointment. I am a marvel. A wonder of creation! I am God's masterpiece!

title: : GROOMED FOR GOD’S GLOR Y
verse: "You are worthy, O Lord our God, to receive glory
body: : GROOMED FOR GOD’S GLOR Y "You are worthy, O Lord our God, to receive glory and honor and power. For you created all things, and they exist because you created what you pleased” (NLT) Rev 4:11 “Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.” God alone created all things – for His sole pleasure. You're groomed for His own glory. The more glory you ascribe to Him, the more glory you radiate effortlessly. Your existence is a privilege from Him. It's not a right. No one lives by his own will. We all live by the will of God. Radiating God's glory and bringing Him glory should be the very first priority of your life. Bring Him glory by your attitude. Bring him glory by your service. Bring Him glory by your sacrifices. Give your pastor, boss and family members a cause to always thank God for your life. “. they will be like great oaks that the Lord has planted for his own glory. You will be called priests of the Lord.” (NLT) Isa 61:3-7
confession: I am radiating His glory more than ever before. I will daily bring Him praise and pleasure by my life. Thank You, dear Lord, for my existence and the privilege of being alive.

title: : FINDING PURPOSE, FULFILLING DESTINY
verse: what the will of the Lord is” (NWB) Eph 5:17
body: : FINDING PURPOSE, FULFILLING DESTINY “Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is” (NWB) Eph 5:17 “The man without a purpose is like a ship without a rudder – a waif, a nothing, a no man” said Thomas Carlyle. Nothing is as nourishing like finding and fulfilling God's purpose on earth, and nothing can make up for not finding and fulfilling it. If you can find it and follow it, you can fulfill it. You can understand God's purpose in the place of communion or through God-consciousness. The more conscious of God you become, the more eager God is to reveal His purpose and help you fulfill the same. Fulfilling God's purpose is in fearing God. “ He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them” (KJV) Ps 145:19. Walk in godly fear and reverence and you'll never cease to be relevant in your generation. Col 4:17 says, “And say to Archippus, See that you discharge carefully [the duties of] the ministry and fulfill the stewardship which you have received in the Lord” (Amp). I bring this divine instruction to a close with Exo 23:26.
prayer: Father, thank You for this overwhelming inspiration. I decree that your plans will not fail concerning my life in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: : LIVING IN THE LIGHT OF ETERNITY
verse: Yet, mortals still can't grasp what God is doing.”
body: : LIVING IN THE LIGHT OF ETERNITY “. He has put a sense of eternity in people's minds. Yet, mortals still can't grasp what God is doing.” (GWT) Ecc 3:11 There is life after life! This very life is a preparation for the next. So, your life must be lived with eternity in focus. You know why? Death brings about a translation; not a termination. Everything a man does has eternal consequences. “The world and all its wanting, wanting, wanting is on the way out - but whoever does what God wants is set for eternity” (TBCL) 1 John 2:17. This world does not continue forever. It will soon be gone! “. What is the nature of your life? You are [really] but a wisp of vapor (a puff of smoke, a mist) that is visible for a little while and then disappears [into thin air]” (Amp) Jam 4:14. “For all flesh (mankind) is like grass, and all its glory (honor) like [the] flower of grass. The grass withers and the flower drops off” (Amp) 1 Pet 1:24. C. S. Lewis captured the concept of eternity, with eternity consciousness, your values change and your goals re-defined.
prayer: Allow God to speak to your heart: Dear Holy Spirit, what are those lifestyles You want me to discontinue and those You want me to embrace even from today? Let Him speak to your heart.

title: : SUCCEED IN MAKING OTHERS SUCCEED
verse: glory of God” (NLT) Rom 6:13
body: : SUCCEED IN MAKING OTHERS SUCCEED “Do not let any part of your body become an instrument of evil to serve sin. So use your whole body as an instrument to do what is right for the glory of God” (NLT) Rom 6:13 1 Pet 4:10-11 says, “God has given each of you a gift from his great variety of spiritual gifts. Use them well to serve one another. Do you have the gift of speaking? Then speak as though God himself were speaking through you. Do you have the gift of helping others? Do it with all the strength and energy that God supplies. Then everything you do will bring glory to God through Jesus Christ. All glory and power to him forever and ever! Amen” (NLT). Your position is to promote kingdom purpose. Your wealth is to enrich others and support God’s project. You've not succeeded until others succeed through you. The more the people succeed through you, the greater your success from God's definition of success. “Be generous with the different things God gave you, passing them around so all get in on it” (TBCL) 1 Pet 4:10.
confession: I’m giving hope to the hopeless. I’m financing kingdom cause. Others will find expression of their destiny though me.

title: : KEEP GOD SMILING AT YOU
verse: “The Lord will smile on you and be kind to you”
body: : KEEP GOD SMILING AT YOU “The Lord will smile on you and be kind to you” (GWT) Num 6:25 Nothing is as sweet as God's smile. His smile makes all the difference. He smiles when you please Him with your life. He smiles when you love and serve Him supremely. If you then want His continual smile, give Him your continual love and service. Serve wherever opportunities come. And do keep His command! Sing with John H. Sammis, 1. When we walk with the Lord in the light of His Word, What a glory He sheds on our way! While we do His good will, He abides with us still, And with all who will trust and obey. 2. Not a shadow can rise, not a cloud in the skies, But His smile quickly drives it away; Not a doubt or a fear, not a sigh or a tear, Can abide while we trust and obey 3. Not a burden we bear, not a sorrow we share, But our toil He doth richly repay; Not a grief or a loss, not a frown or a cross, But is blessed if we trust and obey 4. But we never can prove the delights of His love, Until all on the altar we lay; For the favor He shows, for the joy He bestows, Are for them who will trust and obey.
confession: I’ll love You more, please You more and serve You better – I will keep You smiling at me. This is my decision and conclusion today!

title: : SUCCESS IS NOT IN WISHING
verse: hitherto, and I work” (KJV) John 5:17
body: : SUCCESS IS NOT IN WISHING “But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work” (KJV) John 5:17 How sweet to know! God worked. And so, Jesus worked. Hear Him, “I must work the works.” So direct! So emphatic! He wasn't missing His words. He knew works are rewarding as well as refreshing. Understanding the necessity of timing, He added, “. while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work ” (KJV) John 9:4. You can't dwell in the arena of wish and dwell in the arena of wealth. Wealth responds to work, Pro 18:9. Slothfulness is no gain. You can't be slothful and at the same time be successful. Your mind matters if must matter! Put your mind to your work. Be calculative and be strategic! “Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house” (KJV) Pro 24:27. Gen 2:15 says, “The Lord God took the man and placed him in the garden of Eden to work it and watch over it” (HCSB). Adam wasn't placed in the garden for wishful thinking. He was placed there to work the work and watch over the work, 2 Thes 3:8-12.
prayer: Almighty God, grant me help from on high to be more calculative, strategic and productive at work in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : NEVER SELL YOURSELF IN PURSUIT OF SUCCESS
verse: down and worship me.” (KJV) Matt 4:9-10
body: : NEVER SELL YOURSELF IN PURSUIT OF SUCCESS “. All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.” (KJV) Matt 4:9-10 In affirmative words, Jesus declared, “The thief comes only in order to steal, kill, and destroy. I have come in order that you might have life - life in all its fullness” (TEV) John 10:10. The thief has no other plan than to plunder. So, Satan has no other end in view but to waste the souls of men eternally. No matter what you are looking for, never sell yourself in getting it – don't give in to that satanic allurement. “But cowards, unbelievers, the corrupt, murderers, the immoral, those who practice witchcraft, idol worshipers, and all liars - their fate is in the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death” (NLT) Rev 21:8. Are you trusting God for major breakthroughs, fruit of the womb, husband/wife, job, healing, admission? Stand with Jesus. Never yield to pressure! Jesus can do all of these for you and many more. And He will do them for you. No need seeking after agent of darkness, Isa 8:19-20.
confession: Here I stand, I will never let the devil win the battle. I will never compromise with sin. Though he may try me within, though he may try me without, I will never let the devil win the battle. APRIL 16TH: DON’T BE AFRAID TO START SMALL “Does anyone dare despise this day of small beginnings.” (TBCL) Zec 4:10 “Your beginnings will seem humble, so prosperous will your future be” (NIV) Job 8:7. Starting point is always small - very little and inconsequential - but with tenacity, doggedness and firm resolution, it becomes so big, very significant and lofty. Have you got a big dream in your heart? Have you any dream or got an idea? Any ambition deeply rooted in your spirit? You don't have to wait endlessly? You can start it small and see it grow big. Start where you are with what you have. If you can't start that school in a big way, why not try starting it as day care. That project you being looking for millions for, could be started with that little capital at hand. Stop being afraid! If you have any reason to fear, fear your fear and never fear the future. River Jordan will not part until you take a bold step of faith and dip the first leg into it. The wall of Jericho will not fall until you rise to take a walk round it, Pro 23:18.

title: : YOUR HEAL TH IS VER Y IMPOR TANT
verse: some honeycomb” (NKJV) Luke 24:42
body: : YOUR HEAL TH IS VER Y IMPOR TANT “So they gave Him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb” (NKJV) Luke 24:42 “For I know the plans I have for you, says the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope” (RSV). Jer 29:11. Wow, your welfare is God's concern. His plans are for your good health. You can enjoy good health. This is how: 1. Include fresh fruits and vegetables in your meal frequently, “And God said, "Behold, I have given you every plant yielding seed which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree with seed in its fruit; you shall have them for food” (RSV) Gen 1:29. 2. Avoid worry and anxiety. If good health is your goal - keep away from worry - worry fixes nothing, Phil 4:6. 3. Do water therapy every morning before meal. Drink lots of clean water always. Ezek 4:11. 4. Eat good food. Acts 27:34. 5. Sleep when your body needs it. Stop pushing when you feel tired. Take a vacation when your body is demanding it - listen to your body. When you take good care of your body, your body will in turn take good care of you.
confession: I am taking care. I am keeping away from those habits that hamper health. I will be thoughtful enough to maintain health rules.

title: : NEVER TOO OLD FOR SUCCESS
verse: so is my strength now.” (KJV) Jos 14:11
body: : NEVER TOO OLD FOR SUCCESS “As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now.” (KJV) Jos 14:11 It's never too late either at 40, 60 or 80. Age is no barrier. Eighty-five years was Caleb when he said, “Now therefore give me this mountain.” (KJV) Jos 14:12. Jimmy wales launched Wikipedia at 35, Henry Ford founded Ford Company at 40, Asa Candler founded Coca-cola at 41, Soichiro Honda founded Honda Company at 42, Henry Royce founded Rolls Royce at 43, Sam Walton founded Walmart at 44, Thomas Edison founded General Electric (GE) at 45. What shall I more say of Ray Krooc who started McDonald's at 52. Yoshisuke Aikawa founded Nissan at 53, Kawasaki Shozo Founded Kawasaki at 59. You don't have to possess 'extraordinary' ability to get things done. It's not surprising that Amadeo Giannini founded Bank of America at 60. Charles Flint founded IBM at 61 while Col. Harland Sanders founded KFC at 62. People from different areas of life have started ventures in their 70s and 80s and yet succeeded. Hear this! “[You] shall still bring forth fruit in old age; [You] shall be fat and flourishing” (KJV) Ps 92:14.
confession: Yes, I can! [Pray through as led]

title: : WIND BENEA TH YOUR WINGS
verse: with my victorious right hand” (TLB) Isa 41:10
body: : WIND BENEA TH YOUR WINGS “. Do not be dismayed. I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will help you; I will uphold you with my victorious right hand” (TLB) Isa 41:10 TBCL paints a clear picture of our text, “Don't panic. I'm with you. There's no need to fear for I'm your God. I'll give you strength. I'll help you. I'll hold you steady, keep a firm grip on you.” He said it and He will not fail to do it. “For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, Saying to you, 'Fear not, I will help you.'"Fear not, you worm Jacob, You men of Israel! I will help you," says the LORD And your Redeemer.” (KJV) Isa 41:13-14. Speaking as God's prophet - that miracle you've long awaited for shall be divinely delivered into your hand via angelic intervention this very week. “And blessed (happy, to be envied) is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of the things that were spoken to her from the Lord” (Amp) Luke 1:45. With your conviction of faith, performance is inevitable. “I'm transforming you from worm to harrow, from insect to iron. As a sharp-toothed harrow you'll smooth out the mountains, turn those tough old hills into loamy soil” (TBCL) Isa 41:15.
prayer: I receive angelic intervention this very week in all my ways in Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: : ATTITUDE THAT LIMITS SUCCESS
verse: voice” (AMP) Jer 22:21
body: : ATTITUDE THAT LIMITS SUCCESS “I spoke to you in your [times of] prosperity, but you said, I will not listen! This has been your attitude from your youth; you have not obeyed My voice” (AMP) Jer 22:21 Success, be it as it may, is not final - it's a continuous process. To keep in the flow, you must remain in the know. To be read, you must be a reader. When success in all areas becomes your overriding goal, then you must do all at your disposal to avoid these attitudes. They don't only limit, they put in bondage. 1. Avoid dealing with slack hand, “He who has a slack hand becomes poor.” (KJV) Pro 10:4. 2. Avoid uncontrolled sleep, “. He who sleeps in harvest is a son who causes shame” (KJV) Pro10:5. 3. Avoid slothfulness and practices that are anti-success, “. the lazy man will be put to forced labor” (KJV) Pro 12:24. “Go to the ant, you sluggard! Consider her ways and be wise, Which, having no captain, Overseer or ruler, Provides her supplies in the summer, And gathers her food in the harvest.” (KJV) Pro 6:6-11
confession: To all these - laziness, indiscipline, talkativeness, gluttony, excessive sleep and many more that hinder success, I say NO to you. I reject you. You’ll not reign over me any longer.

title: : WHA T MATTERS MOST
verse: gain nothing by doing all this if I don't have love”
body: : WHA T MATTERS MOST “I may give away everything I have to help others, and I may even give my body as an offering. But I gain nothing by doing all this if I don't have love” (ERV) 1 Cor 13:3 Let's travel through various translations of 1 Cor 13:3, “Even if I dole out all that I have [to the poor in providing] food, and if I surrender my body to be burned or in order that I may glory, but have not love (God's love in me), I gain nothing” (Amp). Giving all without giving love is a mere trash, a fruitless life! “If I give everything I own to the poor and even go to the stake to be burned as a martyr, but I don't love, I've gotten nowhere. So, no matter what I say, what I believe, and what I do, I'm bankrupt without love” (TBCL). Success without love is like soup without salt - tasteless. “Love never gives up. Love cares more for others than for self. Love doesn't want what it doesn't have. Love doesn't strut, Doesn't have a swelled head, Doesn't force itself on others, Isn't always "me first," Doesn't fly off the handle, Doesn't keep score of the sins of others.” 1 Cor 13:4-8.
confession: I seek the welfare of others. I’m not easily provoked. I do not rejoice in iniquity. I bear all things. I don’t keep the record of sins of others.

title: : SUCCEEDING AS A SERVANT
verse: must be your servant” (HCSB) Mark 10:43
body: : SUCCEEDING AS A SERVANT “. whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant” (HCSB) Mark 10:43 We are all without exception made to serve - be it the manager or messenger, the rich or poor, the leader and led - we’re configured for service. So, we must all succeed as servants either as public servants or God's servants. Servanthood is no servitude; it's an opportunity to meet needs. That's a correct spirit of servanthood. Mark 10:43 says, “It's not going to be that way with you. Whoever wants to be great must become a servant” (TBCL). Do you love to be great, then, choose to be a servant. There, you'll find true fulfillment of greatness! Greatness is in ministering - no other way. We serve God by serving others. Though the world defines success in terms of possessions, prestige, power and position. However, God measures true success in terms of service, not status. He determines your success by how many people you serve and not by the number of people who are serving you, 1 Cor 7:22. Service is fulfilling! Never forget to succeed as a servant.
prayer: Lord God, I am ready to succeed as a servant beyond my widest imagination. I ask for all it takes in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : SUCCESS IS NOT SUDDEN
verse: were the sixth day” (NWB) Gen 1:31
body: : SUCCESS IS NOT SUDDEN “And God saw every thing that he had made. it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day” (NWB) Gen 1:31 Between Gen 1:1 and Gen 1:30 were 6 days and nights. That was what it took God! God had sleepless days and nights to succeed as the Creator. Success in life takes a process with a price tag! Winning in life demands works plus wisdom! Are you a minister of the gospel? A Christian musician? An academician? A mechanic? A researcher? A political leader? A government official? A fashion designer? A business tycoon? An industrialist? A furniture maker? All can succeed following God-kind of way. It may take 6 days, 6 weeks, 6 months, 6 years or more to get there. But one thing is sure, if you don't give up, you'll be paid up. “And the earth was without form. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters” (KJV) Gen 1:2. You have to be on the move and be passionate about your dream. Make something out of nothing. Be a creative thinker and creator.
prayer: Dear God, I ask this day, that you wear me like garment – with the power of unbroken focus and tireless pursuit in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : YOU NEED THE WORD TO SUCCEED
verse: sin against thee.” (KJV) Ps 119:11-12
body: : YOU NEED THE WORD TO SUCCEED “Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.” (KJV) Ps 119:11-12 You need His Word if you must succeed in this world. “But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night. And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper” Ps 1:2-3. His Word quickens and empowers you for success. Each dose of the Word contains the quickening power of the Holy Spirit. What the Word does in you is to awaken and quicken your spirit thereby increasing your speed in God. Walk on the Word and walk your life to a worthy cause. “And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power” Luke 4:32. His Word carries a tremendous power of influence and impact. Begin that long Word-search today and search yourself to high-ranking success and significance. His Word empowers you for exploits. “It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life” (KJV) John 6:63.
prayer: Father, I ask for grace to daily search Your Word and always act out the same, Amen.

title: : YOU MUST SUCCEED AS A SPOUSE
verse: love. and be not bitter.” (KJV) Col 3:18-19
body: : YOU MUST SUCCEED AS A SPOUSE “Wives, submit. as it is fit in the Lord. Husbands, love. and be not bitter.” (KJV) Col 3:18-19 The secret of marital success is littered in the pages of the Bible. You don't have to groan to succeed in your marriage. With the right application of the Word, your home turns out to be a haven of comfort, tranquility and growing understanding. “You wives, submit yourselves to your husbands, for that is what the Lord has planned for you” (TLB) Your submission is God's plan. God planned it for the purpose of orderliness and your peace. That's where your real and true beauty lies - in your willingness to submit willingly in everything. The word submission is from the Greek hupotasso meaning to be in subjection. Harshness, bitterness and resentment are not allowed. Christ's standard of love is your yardstick as the husband. She must be loved unconditionally. Love her without comparing her. Accept her uniqueness. Above it all, protect and provide for her needs within your means.
confession: My home shall be heaven on earth - an abode of comfort, tranquility and growing understanding. We shall live to declare Your praise in the land of the living.

title: : SUCCEEDING SPIRITUALL Y
verse: the Lord” (NKJV) Rom 12:11
body: : SUCCEEDING SPIRITUALL Y “Not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord” (NKJV) Rom 12:11 You've not succeeded until you succeed in your spiritual life. Serving God with a heart full of devotion - is a must! The Amplified says, “Never lag in zeal and in earnest endeavor; be aglow and burning with the Spirit, serving the Lord.” Can you take a brief moment to pray that your spirit might be set on fire - that you might love God wholeheartedly. TBCL says, “Don't burn out; keep yourselves fueled and aflame. Be alert servants of the Master.” Keep yourself on fire and blaze brilliantly for your Master who bought and brought you to the fold. Enoch walked with God and succeeded spiritually. “And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him” (KJV) Gen 5:24; Heb 11:5. And so, David walked with God and succeeded. “For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption” (KJV) Acts 13:36. You must succeed spiritually!
prayer: Father, I come against the spirit of spiritual coldness and insensitivity to the things of the Spirit. I ask for a fresh move of the Spirit to awaken my spirit in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: : DIVINE PROVIDENCE IN YOUR DAIL Y PREOCCUP ATION
verse: hope is in you alone” (NLT) Ps 33:22
body: : DIVINE PROVIDENCE IN YOUR DAIL Y PREOCCUP ATION “Let your unfailing love surround us, Lord, for our hope is in you alone” (NLT) Ps 33:22 “I cannot do without You, I cannot do without You, I cannot do without You, Oh Lord!” We all need God - every step of the way - both to lead and guide as well as to usher us into our place in destiny. Rom 9:16 goes, “So then [God's gift] is not a question of human will and human effort, but of God's mercy. [It depends not on one's own willingness nor on his strenuous exertion as in running a race, but on God's having mercy on him]” (Amp). Human effort is of no use where the divine effort is not at work. With His ever-increasing mercy, you enjoy His ever-increasing marvel. It's not in the arm of strength but in the arm of mercy. I prophesy to you as God-ordained prophet that, the kind of mercy-connection that will launch you into the realms of multi-millions and billions is hereby granted to you miraculously in the name of Jesus. You're experiencing mercy-open door, mercy-treatment and mercy-quick reply in the name of Jesus. Take a hold of Ps 60:12.
prayer: Father, I redeem every second ahead of me by the blood of Jesus. I receive everything that belongs to me [Spend time in spiritual warfare].

title: : SUCCESS, WISE LIVING AND TIME MANAGEMENT
verse: apply our hearts unto wisdom” (KJV) Ps 90:12
body: : SUCCESS, WISE LIVING AND TIME MANAGEMENT “So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom” (KJV) Ps 90:12 Time and tide wait for no man. On this was the solemn but serious heartfelt prayer of the Psalmist, “Teach us to number our days carefully so that we may develop wisdom in our hearts” (HBSC). The need for right living along with wise living and excellent time management cannot be overemphasized if we are to achieve all that God wants us to achieve. We must all learn - as a matter of necessity - to live it right, live it wise and live it with timing in mind. You have no reason to say there is no time. Plan your time. Apply the needed discipline. And run with the vision. Mark this in your mind, “There's an opportune time to do things, a right time for everything on the earth: A right time for birth and another for death, A right time to plant and another to reap, A right time to kill and another to heal, A right time to destroy and another to construct, A right time to cry and another to laugh, A right time to lament and another to cheer.” (TBCL) Eccl 3:1-8.
prayer: Dear Lord, I receive the needed wisdom in wise living and excellent time management in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : BEW ARE OF SIN, SIN SINKS SUCCESS
verse: also forsaken you” (KJV) 2 Chro 24:20
body: : BEW ARE OF SIN, SIN SINKS SUCCESS “. Why transgress ye the commandments of the Lord. because ye have forsaken the Lord, he hath also forsaken you” (KJV) 2 Chro 24:20 Sin sinks success and ultimately sinks sinner in hell - a place that burns with fire and brimstone. “These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood, An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief, A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren” (KJV) Pro 6:16-19. We must flee all these to truly succeed here on earth and in eternity. Sin will either take away the Bible or the Bible will take away sin from you. Let the Word of God prevail in all affairs of life. Never allow sin to sink your glorious destiny. “Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it” (KJV) Isa 5:14.
confession: The Bible shall be my guide in all affairs of life. I will read it, study it, meditate on it and memorize some portion of it. I am married to the Word of God. And nothing will take it away from me till I behold His face in glory.

title: : YOU MUST MAKE IT!
verse: may be also” (NKJV) John 14:2-3
body: : YOU MUST MAKE IT! “In My Father's house are many mansions. I go to prepare a place for you. I will come again and receive you to Myself; that where I am, there you may be also” (NKJV) John 14:2-3 In 1920, Mrs A. S. Bridgewater sang: 1. “We read of a place that's called heaven, It's made for the pure and the free; These truths in God's Word He hath given, How beautiful heaven must be. How beautiful heaven must be, Sweet home of the happy and free; Fair haven of rest for the weary, How beautiful heaven must be 2. In heaven no drooping nor pining, No wishing for elsewhere to be; God's light is forever there shining, How beautiful heaven must be.” Heaven is a place we must not miss! “The wall was made of jasper, and the city was pure gold, as clear as glass. The wall of the city was built on foundation stones inlaid with twelve precious stones. The twelve gates were made of pearls - each gate from a single pearl! And the main street was pure gold, as clear as glass.” (KJV) Rev 21:18-27. Give it all it takes to make it. Strive!
prayer: Father, thank You for reminding me of the beauty of that beautiful city. I will never, ever miss it. Do keep me in Your will in Jesus’ name, Amen. “Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place? He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity.” (KJV) Ps 24:3-4 Practical inward and outward purity are both strategic if heaven is our goal. God expects us to be clean within and without. Which President would have his servant with filthy hands wait on his table? If those who were ceremonially unclean could not be allowed to enter into God’s tabernacle built with hands? How will God allow those who are morally unclean abide with Him in His holy tabernacle? True religion is of the heart and from the heart - heart-service, heart-giving, heart-sacrifice, heart-worship, name them - to the Father who created us. “Pure and undefiled religion before God and the Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their affliction, to keep oneself unspotted.” (DB) Jam 1:27. “LORD. who shall dwell in thy holy hill? He that walketh uprightly.” (KJV) Ps 15:1-5.
